explication: stable-worldmodel is a research platform for standardized world-model data collection, training, and model-predictive-control evaluation. The documented workflow configures a vectorized World over supported environments, records episodes through the dataset-format interface, loads clips for model training, then evaluates a policy that plans with a model and solver. Groups distinguish environments, orchestration, data, learning, and planning. The README documents additional dataset backends and reference baselines; those are represented without asserting unsampled implementation wiring.
